# Open Play — HTML review candidate available; exact parity open

Updated 2026-10-16. Full 1:1 parity is NOT verified. Native implementation remains prohibited until Jason approves an identified prototype revision.

The browser review candidate accounts for all 110 current feature groups with real browser behavior, explicit simulations or documented gaps. It includes 495 source-linked requirements, 59 named DJ effects, all eight Setup tabs, five layouts, two/four deck states and six provider fixtures.

Executed browser evidence: local WAV import/load/play, cue/loop/tempo, two-deck master recording, 235,667-byte download/re-import/replay (14.5 seconds), crates, metadata, smart rule, backup/restore, primary panels, settings and synthetic provider/device failures. These checks do not prove full feature parity, native DSP or physical hardware routing.

Open: two groups are independent engineering goals without vendor interaction rows; advanced FX ranges/modes and sonic matching, exact Video catalogs, physical Hercules capture/output, real provider services and many conditional/reference states remain incomplete.

Prototype: https://github.com/jpoindexter/open-play/tree/main/prototype
Review: https://github.com/jpoindexter/open-play/blob/main/docs/prototype/REVIEW_REPORT.md
Plan: https://github.com/jpoindexter/open-play/blob/main/FULL_BUILD_PLAN.md
Claude audit: https://github.com/jpoindexter/open-play/blob/main/handoffs/codex-to-claude-completeness-audit.md

Recommended execution: Codex gpt-6.1-sol / high for browser state/UI; gpt-6-astra / xhigh for hardware evidence. Claude Code claude-sonnet-5 / medium for UI; claude-opus-5 / xhigh for device analysis. Recommendations only; validate availability. Claude audit has not been launched automatically.

Local launch: python3 scripts/serve_prototype.py then http://127.0.0.1:8768/prototype/
Native approval: NOT GRANTED.

Historical functional closure pass: actual reverse/slip/cue hold, sampler gating/pitch/gain, timed Flip, slicer, nested/multi-rule crates, four independent FX processors and local video decode/composition/capture are now implemented. 20/20 browser audio/module checks passed; main UI workflows were exercised. Recorded video mix was downloaded and replayed. Real MIDI input code exists but this browser's access request timed out; synthetic mappings alone do not prove physical input. Full 1:1 parity remains NOT PASSED. See docs/prototype/FUNCTIONAL_REVIEW.md for exact evidence and limits.

## DSP checkpoint — 16 October 2026
All 59 named DJ effects have independent audio processors. The 55 extended effects expose 220 observed controls; actual AudioWorklet contrasts passed 220/220. The original four effects' 16 controls passed 16/16 Web Audio contrasts. Exact reference ranges, enum catalogs and sonic response remain unverified. All four adversarial defects are corrected and pass nine longer actual browser Worklet checks; the frozen runtime also passed59/59 graphs and5/5 original lifecycle checks.
Actual keylock Worker: 12/12; engine integration: 18/18; sampler: 17/17; Pitch Play: 13/13; analysis Worker: 13/13 and controller: 14/14. Stems/Channel lifecycle: 27/27, including active tails across pitch/rate/seek/reverse, natural end and emergency silence. Main UI first Stems action, Analyze Stems on load and Prepared-crate drag reached real SCNet four-source readiness; cancellation/retry and coalesced pad actions were exercised. Current integration baseline20/20. Public sampler route checks held Playing while Deck1/fader-zero measured zero and Master measured0.01887; physical headphone routing remains unverified. Model quality still has a failed 3% reconstruction gate (3.025%).
Inventory: 110 groups and 495 requirements; all 59 advanced strips/236 labels observed. Counts are scoped evidence, not full parity. GATE-P remains open and full 1:1 parity is NOT PASSED. Native approval remains NOT GRANTED.
Plan: FULL_BUILD_PLAN.md sections 23–26. Evidence: docs/prototype/DSP_FUNCTIONAL_REVIEW.md. Current audit: handoffs/codex-to-claude-completeness-audit.md. Repository checkpoint and handoff are updated as behavior is verified; no native development.

Stem Slip source correction: REQ-493–495 add latched selection, independent selected-stem transport and vocal-only crossfader behavior. Serato quickstart release wording conflicts with Hercules manual. Independent browser split transport is now implemented and tested; exact reference policies remain open; see docs/research/STEM_SLIP_EVALUATION.md. No mute-only fixture counts as parity.
Source/functional queues reconciled:87 source-link descriptions verified;13 historical functional additions exact-readback verified and4 superseded by newer DSP evidence;0 pending. These are record-sync counts, not acceptance.

## Stem Slip browser continuation — 16 October 2026
Actual selected/backing clocks, signed PCM scratch, cue holds, musical release and selected-only crossfader routing:30/30 real browser AudioWorklet/engine checks;30/30 kernel/engine-boundary checks;19/19 controller lifecycle checks. Public main UI preparedSCNet audio, retained focus, performed held/quick keyboard release and rejoined; explicit pause stopped playback. Existing18 engine,27 Channel/Stems and20 ordinary behavior checks passed. ExactT10 conflict/hardware/topology/combined workflows/resource limits remain open; fullparity NOT PASSED; nativeapproval NOT GRANTED.
Evidence: https://github.com/jpoindexter/open-play/blob/main/docs/prototype/STEM_SLIP_FUNCTIONAL_REVIEW.md
